text:
### Retention  
- **Keep:** 7 years (supports audit trail, regulatory inquiries)
- **Location:** Secure risk repository (encrypted)
- **Access:** Risk team + process owner only

raw_entities.name: Audit Trail and Regulatory Inquiry Risk
raw_entities.description: Risk associated with maintaining adequate audit trails and documentation to support regulatory inquiries and compliance investigations. The organization maintains a 7-year retention policy to mitigate this risk.
context: Keep: 7 years (supports audit trail, regulatory inquiries)

raw_entities.name: Data Security and Access Control Risk
raw_entities.description: Risk of unauthorized access to sensitive risk documentation and audit materials. Mitigated through encrypted storage in a secure repository with restricted access limited to the risk team and process owner.
context: Access: Risk team + process owner only

raw_entities.name: Risk Team
raw_entities.description: Internal department responsible for risk management, audit trail maintenance, and access control to the secure risk repository. Shares access privileges with the process owner.
context: Access: Risk team + process owner only
